import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
plugin = pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-advisory-4b694214/kk/0.23.0')
bundle = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='kk-export-preview-review-'))
base = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
files = ['preview.py', 'routes.py', 'config.py', 'settings.py', 'tests/test_routes.py', 'README.md', 'tasks.md']
entries=[]
for path in files:
    data = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', ':' + path])
    dest = bundle / 'candidate' / path
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest.write_bytes(data)
    dest.chmod(0o444)
    entries.append({'role':'candidate', 'repository':str(root), 'revision':'index based on ' + base, 'original_path':path, 'artifact':str(dest), 'blob':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',':'+path],text=True).strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'original_lines':[1,len(data.splitlines())],'omitted_or_redacted':'none'})
for path in ['routes.py','config.py','settings.py','tests/test_routes.py']:
    data=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+path])
    dest=bundle/'baseline'/path
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    dest.write_bytes(data)
    dest.chmod(0o444)
    entries.append({'role':'historical', 'repository':str(root),'revision':base,'original_path':path,'artifact':str(dest),'blob':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',base+':'+path],text=True).strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'original_lines':[1,len(data.splitlines())],'omitted_or_redacted':'none'})
diff=bundle/'staged.patch'
diff.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--no-ext-diff']))
diff.chmod(0o444)
criteria=[str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/x) for x in ['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']]
criteria += [str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/x) for x in ['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']]
assert len(criteria)==8 and len(set(criteria))==8 and all(pathlib.Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
manifest={'selector':'git diff --cached; explicit user selection', 'base':base,'candidate':'immutable index-blob snapshots; no unstaged tracked differences at collection','criteria':criteria,'diff':str(diff),'evidence':entries,'missing_evidence':'PAL tools unavailable. No named release/deployment baseline is specified by the repository.'}
(bundle/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
